scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a housing loan and I'm trying to check the status. Could you tell me if my application has been approved, denied, or is still pending? Also, what type of loan was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your application for a conventional loan to refinance your home has been denied. The only reason for the denial given in the record is that your debt-to-income ratio was too high.

dialogue.user: I see. Could you explain what a high debt-to-income ratio means in this context, and is there anything I can do to address this issue for future applications? Also, what is my assigned interest rate and the total costs of this loan?
dialogue.agent:
A high debt-to-income ratio (DTI) means that your monthly debt payments are too high relative to your monthly income. In your case, your DTI ratio was between 50% and 60%, which is considered too high for this loan.

Unfortunately, your loan application was denied, so there is no interest rate or total loan costs associated with it. I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

dialogue.user: I understand. Is there any information on whether my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? Also, are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has not been transferred or sold to another institution. This field is not applicable because the loan was denied. Additionally, there are no high-cost or negative amortization flags on your loan.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for the information. I appreciate your help.

<Neutral> The agent provided clear and accurate information about my loan application status and the reasons for denial. However, I was hoping for a different outcome, so I'm feeling neutral about the interaction.
